name: drama_narration
notes: Ordinary drama projects: server gates are always open, script/confirm is a no-op, fill-gaps/design cards/combo/layer segments/skeleton are documentary-only. The workflow, not the server, enforces order.
Poster: every episode needs an explicit decision. required_poster=true in workflow.json means the final gate needs an approved selected version; otherwise a poster_waiver decision is required.

steps.name: 授权与 profile
steps.done: workflow.json initialised with authorization wording, fixed models, poster policy

steps.name: AI 改写
steps.done: script_content saved by Huobao and read back

steps.name: 稿件批准
steps.done: script_approval decision bound to script_content hash (script/confirm is a no-op for drama)

steps.name: 资产
steps.done: every bound asset has an opened image; faithful maps never enter diffusion

steps.name: Poster
steps.done: selected version + poster_approval, or poster_waiver when not required

steps.name: 拆镜与旁白分配
steps.done: canonical order file; narration concatenated in that order equals script_content

steps.name: 配音（实测时长，不加速）
steps.done: narration_status voiced, audio text sha == text sha, no narration_too_long/voice_stale

steps.name: 关键帧提示词
steps.done: required slot prompts non-empty, mid_frame_time inside (0,duration), no blocking ref_issues

steps.name: 视频提示词
steps.done: timeline contiguous from 0 and ends at duration; video_prompt_review decision

steps.name: 关键帧审核与确认
steps.done: keyframe_approval bound to current images, keyframes confirmed

steps.name: 视频
steps.done: video_approval bound to video_url after opening start/mid/end

steps.name: 合成
steps.done: compose preview unchanged + exportable, compose_approval bound to composed_video_url

steps.name: 导出
steps.done: merged file downloaded, fully decoded, opened at boundaries

concurrency.allowed: different batch types may run together when their shots differ (e.g. video batch for confirmed shots while a keyframe batch serves others)
concurrency.frozen_inputs: a shot queued in a running batch or targeted by an unfinished call cannot have its prompts/narration changed
